title: ML↔QA-001: On-Device Model Validation + Parity Results
description: Edge AI/ML provides the model, parity test vectors, acceptance criteria, evaluation methodology, and preprocessing golden vectors; QA provides on-device validation results, parity/accuracy outcomes, and edge-case/robustness findings. Grounded in EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6 and QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2.

acceptance_criteria.description: ML→QA: acceptance thresholds and evaluation methodology.

parity_tolerance.description: Allowed deviation between on-device and golden-reference output.

parity_test_vectors_path.description: Path to input→expected-output parity vectors and preprocessing golden vectors.

parity_passed.description: On-device output matches golden reference within parity_tolerance.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Release-gate model validation; a FAIL feeds the QA go/no-go (Tier-1). Accuracy-threshold or parity-tolerance changes are model-deployment decisions requiring ADR consultation.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (acceptance-criteria handoff at planning; on-device validation during execution; release-gate sign-off)
confirm_conditions: acceptance_criteria fully specified (accuracy metric+threshold, latency ceiling, parity tolerance)
verdict = PASS only when all above hold
reject_conditions: verdict = PASS while measured_accuracy < threshold or latency over ceiling
acceptance criteria missing a quantified threshold or unit
counter_conditions: edge_case_findings reveal a robustness gap not covered by criteria — request criteria extension (map to relevant FMEA FC-ID)
parity marginal within noise — request a larger vector set before sign-off
